title: Says “mehaq”
description: Gyani Maiya Sen-Kusunda saying the word "mehaq" (literally, "ban-raja" or forest-king, and a reference to a Kusunda person) in the Kusunda language. This audio is extracted from media recorded by Subhashish Panigrahi for the 2019/2023 documentary film Gyani Maiya. The original recording from 2018 includes an interview in which Gyani Maiya Sen-Kusunda answers several questions asked by Uday Raj Aaley in Nepali based on broader questions by Panigrahi. Sen-Kusunda answers mostly in Kusunda and occasionally in Nepali.
